C : Type u₁

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hfg, hgf⟩

    rcases hfg with ⟨hfg₁, hfg₂⟩
    rcases hgf with ⟨hgf₁, hgf₂⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨g.1, hfg₁, hgf₁⟩⟩, ⟨⟨g.2, hfg₂, hgf₂⟩⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨g₁, hfg₁, hgf₁⟩, ⟨g₂, hfg₂, hgf₂⟩⟩
    dsimp at hfg₁ hgf₁ hfg₂ hgf₂

    repeat { simp; constructor; assumption; assumption }
